data_objects.name: country_year_case_estimates
data_objects.meaning: Country-year estimates of cases and deaths, including point estimates, lower and upper bounds, and WHO regional grouping.
data_objects.notes: The health condition to which the estimates refer is not named in the table.

variables.name: Year
variables.meaning: Calendar year associated with the estimates.

variables.name: No. of cases
variables.meaning: Display-form case estimate, encoded either as a count or as a point estimate followed by bracketed lower and upper bounds.

variables.name: No. of deaths
variables.meaning: Display-form death estimate, encoded either as a count or as a point estimate followed by bracketed lower and upper bounds.

variables.name: No. of cases_median
variables.meaning: Numeric median or central estimate of the number of cases.

variables.name: No. of cases_min
variables.meaning: Numeric lower bound accompanying the case estimate.

variables.name: No. of cases_max
variables.meaning: Numeric upper bound accompanying the case estimate.

variables.name: No. of deaths_median
variables.meaning: Numeric median or central estimate of the number of deaths.

variables.name: No. of deaths_min
variables.meaning: Numeric lower bound accompanying the death estimate.

variables.name: No. of deaths_max
variables.meaning: Numeric upper bound accompanying the death estimate.

variables.name: WHO Region
variables.meaning: World Health Organization region assigned to the country.

structure.description: Each row is a country-year estimate; Country plus Year acts as the candidate key and WHO Region groups countries.
No. of cases and No. of deaths are formatted composite representations of the corresponding median, minimum, and maximum numeric fields.
Empty CSV cells encode unavailable lower or upper bounds.

uncertainties: The disease or health condition represented by the case and death counts is not identified.
The statistical interpretation and confidence level of the minimum and maximum bounds are not stated.
The source does not define whether median is a posterior median, modeled central estimate, or another summary.
annotation_notes: The semantic map is grounded only in train.csv and does not infer a condition not named by that table.
